description: Retrieve the current corpus statistics — live counts and distributions of events, Coordination Connections (CCs), and Sovereign Capability Profile actors across bloc, tier, domain, event type, primary industry, CC type, confidence, and designation, plus Environmental Nexus Tag (ENT) statistics with the Warmth Engine Ratio, counts of the derived layers — Infrastructure Threads, Capability Links with their type split, and Capability Signatures — the event-ID range, and the methodology version. Capability Link and Capability Signature counts are of active records only: retired records are excluded so the figures describe present coverage rather than everything ever assessed, with the active/retired splits published in the two capability tools' metadata. No parameters; figures are computed live, so the response always reflects the present database. The secondary-industry breakdown is full-tier only.
name: get_coverage_stats
title: Get Coverage Statistics
